meta.title: Wolter Invest — physical assets, monthly profit share, clear numbers
meta.description: Bikes and power for couriers. A monthly profit share for you. You finance the equipment; Wolter manages the day-to-day operation.

site.heroDesc: Bikes and power for couriers. A monthly profit share for you. You finance the equipment; Wolter manages the day-to-day operation.
site.heroDisclosure: Returns depend on actual profit and are not guaranteed. Paid in UZS. Proposed term: 48 months; early exit is not guaranteed.
site.rewardNote: USD equivalents. Both amounts assume unchanged operating profit.
site.benefit1Text: The proposed structure places the equipment in your name during the lease.
site.benefit2Text: The team manages riders, rentals and routine servicing.
site.benefit3Text: Monthly reporting shows distributable profit and your share.
site.howEyebrow: 01 / WHAT YOUR CAPITAL PUTS TO WORK
site.howDesc: E-bike rental and battery swapping work together. This equipment makes up one proposed investment unit.
site.cabinetDesc: A network point for battery exchanges.
site.batteryDesc: A ratio of 1.5 batteries per bike.
site.stream1Text: Riders pay to rent an electric bike.
site.stream2Text: Battery service generates subscription or pay-per-use revenue.
site.flowTitle:
Know your share.
At every stage.
site.flowDesc: The proposed 48-month structure is shown below. Your signed agreements define the precise rights and responsibilities.
site.phase1Text: You receive 70% of distributable net profit; Wolter receives 30%.
site.phase2Text: You receive 30% of distributable net profit; Wolter receives 70%.
site.phaseEndText: The proposal transfers the assets to Wolter. Confirm what happens if capital has not been recovered before signing.
site.sharedNote: Operating expenses are paid from revenue and affect your share. Check asset wear, major maintenance and insurance responsibilities in the documents.
site.evidenceTitle:
See the evidence.
Then make your decision.
site.evidenceDesc: Monthly revenue from 2026, the 2025 pilot and the investor model — each figure has its own period and calculation basis.
site.pilotNote: Reported 48-day pilot data, not a live active-user count or an independent audit. Request updated operating results with the documents.
site.modelDesc: Source inputs supplied in the repository. These are not presented as independently audited financial statements.
site.modelExplain: Swap revenue is normalized to 30 days and divided across 14 model clusters. Rental revenue is scaled from 200 bikes to 14 bikes per new cluster. Cost percentages are deducted before profit sharing.
site.modelLimits: The model holds profit flat for 48 months. Additional replacement costs, investor taxes, delays and exchange-rate changes are not separately modeled. The pilot ratio of 10 bikes per cabinet becomes 14 in a new cluster.
site.risksTitle:
Clarity is the
basis of confidence.
site.risksDesc: Understand the terms that affect your capital alongside the potential reward.
site.risk1Text: Payments depend on actual profit and may fall or be zero. Some or all of your capital may be lost. Model scenarios are not probability estimates.
site.risk2Text: Payments are in UZS. Their dollar equivalent changes with the exchange rate. The term is 48 months; an early sale or exit is not guaranteed.
site.risk3Text: Review ownership documents, insurance coverage and the recovery process if the operator stops. GPS and physical assets do not guarantee full recovery.
site.risk4Text: The proposal is designed around Ijarah / Ijarah Muntahia Bittamleek and AAOIFI 9. Request independent Shariah and local legal opinions on the final contracts. Legal review is ongoing.
site.teamNote: Roles are company-reported. Advisor involvement does not guarantee investor capital or returns.
site.ctaTitle:
First, the details.
Then, your decision.
site.ctaDesc: Request the model and contracts. Review the numbers and ask your questions. Requesting documents creates no investment commitment.
site.docNote: Confirm document availability, currency and legal-opinion status in your conversation.
site.footerAbout: Mobility and power for couriers. A clear partnership for investors.
site.footerLegal: GETNOW LLC · Tashkent, Uzbekistan. This page explains the proposed investment and is not a public offering of securities. Model results are illustrative; returns and capital recovery are not guaranteed. An asset-based lease structure, not company equity. Legal review is ongoing.

calc.title:
Choose your investment.
Understand your returns.
calc.desc: Explore illustrative cash flows for one or more clusters. Every result comes from the same transparent formula.
calc.scenarioNote: −15% / 0% / +15% applied to net profit. No likelihood is assigned.
calc.stressNote: 0% means no profit; 100% is the base model. This is a stress calculation, not a forecast.
calc.noPhase2: Phase 2 is not reached within 48 months
calc.gainNote: Before additional investor costs and taxes.
calc.chartDesc: The capital line marks your initial investment; the chart is not the asset’s market value.
calc.irrNote: IRR accounts for cash-flow timing. It is not a fixed annual payment or a guaranteed rate.
calc.note: Illustrative calculation. Payments are in UZS; USD display uses 1 USD = 12,000 UZS, not a live rate. Profit is held flat for 48 months. Capital recovery and early exit are not guaranteed.
calc.limits: Additional maintenance/replacements, investor taxes, delays and FX changes are excluded. Scaling is linear. The share changes in the month after capital recovery.

revenue.label: COMPANY-REPORTED RESULTS
revenue.title: Monthly revenue. Two sources.
revenue.chartDescription: Monthly total revenue in million UZS: May 238.5; June 371.9; July 404.6; August 382.4. Revenue fell 5.5% from July to August. Exact values are in the table below.
revenue.tableCaption: May–August 2026. All amounts in UZS. Rental count is not a count of bikes or unique customers.
revenue.source: Source: company-supplied table received 13 September 2026. The owner confirmed UZS currency and that “E-bike rental” counts rental events. Figures are not presented as independently audited.
